      - uses: &Upload actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with: { name: prepared-release, path: "${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-action", if-no-files-found: error }
  nix:
    needs: prepare
    uses: $/.github/workflows/nix.yml
    with: { tag: "v${{ inputs.version }}" }
  action:
    name: Candidate Action (${{ matrix.os }})
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { os: ubuntu-latest, platform: linux_amd64, extension: tar.gz, suffix: "" }
          - { os: macos-latest, platform: darwin_arm64, extension: tar.gz, suffix: "" }
          - { os: windows-latest, platform: windows_amd64, extension: zip, suffix: .exe }
    steps:
      - uses: *Checkout
        with: { ref: "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}", fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: &SetupNode actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with: &Node24 { node-version: "24", package-manager-cache: false }
      - uses: &Download actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: prepared-release, path: "${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-action" }
      - name: Materialize the normal version tag and verified binary
        env:
          CANDIDATE: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.candidate }}
          PLATFORM: ${{ matrix.platform }}
          EXTENSION: ${{ matrix.extension }}
          BINARY_SUFFIX: ${{ matrix.suffix }}
        run: |
          assets="${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-action/assets"
          git bundle verify "${assets}/release-candidate.bundle"
          git fetch --no-tags "${assets}/release-candidate.bundle" "refs/actionlint/candidates/v${VERSION}:refs/tags/v${VERSION}"
          tag_commit="$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/v${VERSION}^{commit}")"
          test "${tag_commit}" = "${CANDIDATE}"
          mkdir .actionlint-action-candidate
          git archive "v${VERSION}" | tar -x -C .actionlint-action-candidate
          (cd .actionlint-action-candidate && sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS)
          (cd "${assets}" && sha256sum --check "actionlint_${VERSION}_checksums.txt")
          archive="${assets}/actionlint_${VERSION}_${PLATFORM}.${EXTENSION}"
          binary_dir="${RUNNER_TEMP}/candidate-binary"
          mkdir "${binary_dir}"
          if [[ "${EXTENSION}" == zip ]]; then
            unzip -q "${archive}" -d "${binary_dir}"
          else
            tar -xz -C "${binary_dir}" < "${archive}"
          fi
          echo "ACTIONLINT_ACTION_BINARY=${binary_dir}/actionlint${BINARY_SUFFIX}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
      - name: Test the packaged entrypoint, published plugin and GitHub cache
        uses: $/.github/actions/test-action
        with: { action-directory: .actionlint-action-candidate, binary: "${{ env.ACTIONLINT_ACTION_BINARY }}" }
      - name: Exercise the candidate through the real runner
        id: smoke
        # ./ loads the candidate tree generated during this job.
        uses: ./.actionlint-action-candidate
        with: { files: internal/development/tests/integration/workflow/testdata/ok/minimal.yaml, format: json }
      - name: Verify runner outputs and exported actionlint
        env:
          EXIT_CODE: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.exit-code }}
          RESULT: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.result }}
          PROBLEM_COUNT: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.problem-count }}
          OUTPUT: ${{ steps.smoke.outputs.output }}
        run: |
          node applications/github-action/tests/check-action-outputs.mjs
          actionlint -version
      - name: Verify Windows command resolution
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          actionlint -version
          exit $LASTEXITCODE
      - name: Run the prepared Windows x86-64 wheel
        if: runner.os == 'Windows'
        uses: $/.github/actions/pypi-wheels
        with: { version: "${{ inputs.version }}", out-dir: "${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-action/assets", smoke: win_amd64 }
  container:
    name: Build and test candidate container (${{ matrix.target }})
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 40
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - { target: cli, asset: actionlint-container }
          - { target: action, asset: actionlint-action-container }
    env: { CONTAINER_ASSET: "${{ matrix.asset }}", CONTAINER_TARGET: "${{ matrix.target }}" }
    steps:
      - uses: *Checkout
        with: { ref: "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}", fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: *Download
        with: { name: prepared-release, path: "${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-action" }

        env: { CANDIDATE: "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.candidate }}" }
        run: |
          git fetch --no-tags "${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-action/assets/release-candidate.bundle" "refs/actionlint/candidates/v${VERSION}"
          fetched_commit="$(git rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)"
          test "${fetched_commit}" = "${CANDIDATE}"
          git checkout --detach "${CANDIDATE}"
      - uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@99012661954931238ded8c8b007157a8430204e1 # v4.4.0
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4.4.1
      - name: Build a portable multi-platform image
        id: build
        uses: docker/build-push-action@c3c9e263c25d99ce0380d002d59b67737d91b0dc # v7.4.0
        with:
          context: .
          file: distribution/docker/Dockerfile
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          target: ${{ matrix.target }}
          build-args: ACTIONLINT_VER=${{ inputs.version }}
          outputs: type=oci,dest=${{ runner.temp }}/${{ matrix.asset }}_${{ inputs.version }}.tar
          sbom: true
          provenance: mode=max
          tags: actionlint:candidate-${{ matrix.target }}
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.version=${{ inputs.version }}
            org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ needs.prepare.outputs.candidate }}
      - name: Record the prepared image digest before immutable tagging
        env: { DIGEST: "${{ steps.build.outputs.digest }}" }
        run: |
          [[ "${DIGEST}" =~ ^sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]]
          printf '%s\n' "${DIGEST}" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/${CONTAINER_ASSET}_${VERSION}.digest"
      - name: Test both platforms from the stored OCI archive
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends skopeo
          for arch in amd64 arm64; do
            image="actionlint:candidate-${CONTAINER_TARGET}-${arch}"
            skopeo --override-os linux --override-arch "${arch}" copy \
              "oci-archive:${RUNNER_TEMP}/${CONTAINER_ASSET}_${VERSION}.tar" "docker-daemon:${image}"
            if [[ "${CONTAINER_TARGET}" == action ]]; then
              bash distribution/docker/test-docker-action.bash "${image}" "linux/${arch}"
            else
              bash distribution/docker/test-docker-ruff.bash "${image}" "linux/${arch}"
              bash distribution/docker/test-docker-plugins.bash "${image}" "linux/${arch}"
              docker run --rm --platform "linux/${arch}" --mount type=bind,source="${PWD}",target=/w \
                "${image}" internal/development/tests/integration/workflow/testdata/ok/minimal.yaml
              status=0
              docker run --rm --platform "linux/${arch}" --mount type=bind,source="${PWD}",target=/w \
                "${image}" internal/development/tests/integration/workflow/testdata/err/one_error.yaml || status=$?
              test "${status}" = 1
            fi
          done
      - uses: *Upload
        with:
          name: prepared-container-${{ matrix.target }}
          path: |
            ${{ runner.temp }}/${{ matrix.asset }}_${{ inputs.version }}.tar
            ${{ runner.temp }}/${{ matrix.asset }}_${{ inputs.version }}.digest
          if-no-files-found: error
          compression-level: 0
  manifest:
    name: Record the validated release candidate
    needs: [prepare, nix, action, container]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: *Checkout
        with: { ref: "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}", fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: *SetupNode
        with: *Node24
      - uses: *Download
        with: { name: prepared-release, path: "${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-action" }
      - uses: *Download
        with: { pattern: prepared-container-*, merge-multiple: true, path: "${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-action/assets" }
      - name: Record every tested asset and candidate commit
        env: { SOURCE: "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}", CANDIDATE: "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.candidate }}" }
        run: |
          assets="${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-action/assets"
          git fetch --no-tags "${assets}/release-candidate.bundle" "refs/actionlint/candidates/v${VERSION}"
          node tools/release/release-candidate.mjs manifest --version "${VERSION}" --directory "${assets}" --source "${SOURCE}" --candidate "${CANDIDATE}"
      - name: Preserve the manifest independently of the editable draft
        uses: *Upload
        with:
          name: release-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-action/assets/release-candidate.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 90
  draft:
    name: Store the validated release draft
    needs: [prepare, manifest]
    if: ${{ !inputs.validation-only }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions: { contents: write }
    steps:
      - uses: *Checkout
        with: { ref: "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}", fetch-depth: 0, persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: *Download
        with: { name: prepared-release, path: "${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-action" }
      - uses: *Download
        with: { pattern: prepared-container-*, merge-multiple: true, path: "${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-action/assets" }
      - uses: *Download
        with:
          name: release-candidate-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/actionlint-action/assets
      - name: Create the draft without publishing a version tag
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}", SOURCE: "${{ needs.prepare.outputs.source }}" }
        run: |
          if gh release view "v${VERSION}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            echo '::error::A release or draft already exists. Inspect it before preparing another candidate.'
            exit 1
          fi
          remote_tag="$(git ls-remote origin "refs/tags/v${VERSION}")"
          test -z "${remote_tag}"
          gh release create "v${VERSION}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --draft --target "${SOURCE}" \
            --title "v${VERSION}" --notes-file "${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-action/release-notes.md"
          gh release upload "v${VERSION}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/actionlint-action/assets/"*
          remote_tag="$(git ls-remote origin "refs/tags/v${VERSION}")"
          test -z "${remote_tag}"
          printf 'Prepared **v%s**. Promote the validated draft with:\n\n    node tools/release/release-candidate.mjs promote --version %s --run %s\n' \
            "${VERSION}" "${VERSION}" "${GITHUB_RUN_ID}" >> "${GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY}"

        run: |
          [[ "${TAG}" =~ ^v(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)\.(0|[1-9][0-9]*)$ ]]
          object="$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/${TAG}")"
          object_type="$(git cat-file -t "${object}")"
          test "${object_type}" = tag
          tag_object="$(git cat-file -p "${object}")"
          grep -q -- '-----BEGIN PGP SIGNATURE-----' <<< "${tag_object}"
          verified="$(gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/git/tags/${object}" --jq '.verification.verified')"
          test "${verified}" = true
          tag_commit="$(git rev-parse "refs/tags/${TAG}^{commit}")"
          test "${tag_commit}" = "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          gh release download "${TAG}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-assets"
          node tools/release/release-candidate.mjs verify --directory "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-assets"
          manifest="${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-assets/release-candidate.json"
          candidate_tag="$(jq -r .tag "${manifest}")"
          test "${candidate_tag}" = "${TAG}"
          candidate_commit="$(jq -r .candidate "${manifest}")"
          test "${candidate_commit}" = "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          run_id="$(jq -r .run_id "${manifest}")"
          attempt="$(jq -r .run_attempt "${manifest}")"
          gh api "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${run_id}" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/prepare-run.json"
          node --input-type=module <<'NODE'
          import { readFile } from 'node:fs/promises';
          import { join } from 'node:path';
          import { parseManifest, verifyRun } from './tools/release/release-candidate.mjs';
          const read = async (name) => JSON.parse(await readFile(join(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP, name), 'utf8'));
          const manifest = parseManifest(await read('release-assets/release-candidate.json'));
          if (manifest.repository !== process.env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY) throw new Error('Candidate repository differs');
          verifyRun(await read('prepare-run.json'), manifest);
          NODE
          gh run download "${run_id}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" \
            --name "release-candidate-${run_id}-${attempt}" --dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/trusted-candidate"
          cmp "${manifest}" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/trusted-candidate/release-candidate.json"
          cmp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-assets/actionlint-action_${TAG#v}.mjs" action.mjs
          {
            echo "version=${TAG#v}"
            echo "candidate=${GITHUB_SHA}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Select eligible moving references
        id: tags
        run: |
          version="${TAG#v}"
          major="${version%%.*}"
          minor="${version%.*}"
          latest_stable_tag() {
            local pattern="$1" candidate tags
            tags="$(git tag --list "${pattern}" --sort=-version:refname)" || return
            while IFS= read -r candidate; do
              if [[ "${candidate}" =~ ^v[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
                echo "${candidate}"
                return
              fi
            done <<< "${tags}"
            return 1
          }
          for scope in latest major-latest minor-latest; do
            case "${scope}" in
              latest) pattern='v*.*.*' ;;
              major-latest) pattern="v${major}.*.*" ;;
              minor-latest) pattern="v${minor}.*" ;;
              *) exit 1 ;;
            esac
            eligible=false
            latest="$(latest_stable_tag "${pattern}")"
            if [[ "${TAG}" == "${latest}" ]]; then eligible=true; fi
            echo "is-${scope}=${eligible}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          done
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4
        with: { subject-checksums: "${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets/actionlint_${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}_checksums.txt" }
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4
        with: { subject-path: "${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets/actionlint-action_${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}.mjs" }
      - name: Attest the verified publication manifest for downstream receivers
        uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4
        with: { subject-path: "${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets/release-candidate.json" }
      - name: Detect released wheels
        id: wheels
        run: |
          present=false
          if compgen -G "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-assets/*.whl" > /dev/null; then present=true; fi
          echo "present=${present}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4
        if: steps.wheels.outputs.present == 'true'
        with: { subject-path: "${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets/*.whl" }
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with: { name: verified-release, path: "${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets", if-no-files-found: error, compression-level: 0 }
  npm:
    name: Publish npm packages
    needs: verify
    permissions: { contents: read, actions: read, id-token: write }
    uses: $/.github/workflows/npm-release.yml
    with: { tag: "${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}" }
  distributions:
    name: Publish prepared AUR packages
    needs: verify
    if: needs.verify.outputs.is-latest == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment: { name: aur }
    steps:
      - uses: *Checkout
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: *SetupNode
        with: *Node24
      - uses: &Download actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with: { name: verified-release, path: .release-assets }
      - name: Publish the prepared AUR binary package
        uses: &DeployAUR KSXGitHub/github-actions-deploy-aur@084b0d9b15415bf9cdb65d44dad1efe37a354050 # v4.2.0
        with:
          pkgname: actionlint-kjanat-bin
          pkgbuild: .release-assets/actionlint-kjanat-bin.pkgbuild
          updpkgsums: false
          test: false
          post_process: cp "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.release-assets/actionlint-kjanat-bin.srcinfo" .SRCINFO
          commit_username: ${{ vars.COMMIT_USER }}
          commit_email: ${{ vars.COMMIT_EMAIL }}
          ssh_private_key: ${{ secrets.AUR_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          commit_message: Update to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
      - name: Publish the prepared AUR source package
        uses: *DeployAUR
        with:
          pkgname: actionlint-kjanat
          pkgbuild: .release-assets/actionlint-kjanat.pkgbuild
          updpkgsums: false
          test: false
          post_process: cp "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/.release-assets/actionlint-kjanat.srcinfo" .SRCINFO
          commit_username: ${{ vars.COMMIT_USER }}
          commit_email: ${{ vars.COMMIT_EMAIL }}
          ssh_private_key: ${{ secrets.AUR_SSH_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          commit_message: Update to ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
  pypi:
    name: Publish PyPI wheels
    needs: verify
    permissions: { contents: read, attestations: read, id-token: write }
    uses: $/.github/workflows/pypi-release.yml
    with: { tag: "${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}" }

    name: Submit verified WinGet manifests
    needs: verify
    if: needs.verify.outputs.is-latest == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions: { contents: read, issues: write }
    steps:
      - uses: *Checkout
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: *SetupNode
        with: *Node24
      - uses: *Download
        with: { name: verified-release, path: .release-assets }
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2
        with: { bun-version: "1.4.4" }
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Generate the manifests from the published release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
          WINGET_CHECKSUMS: .release-assets/actionlint_${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}_checksums.txt
          WINGET_RELEASE_NOTES: ${{ runner.temp }}/release-notes.md
          WINGET_OUT: ${{ runner.temp }}/winget
        run: |
          gh release view "${TAG}" --repo "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" --json body --jq .body > "${WINGET_RELEASE_NOTES}"
          node distribution/winget/src/cli.ts generate
      - name: Submit once or report why submission is blocked
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
          WINGET_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.WINGET_TOKEN }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node tools/release/release-assets.mjs publish-winget "${RUNNER_TEMP}/winget" "${VERSION}"

    name: Report a failed WinGet job
    needs: [verify, winget]
    if: always() && needs.verify.result == 'success' && (needs.winget.result == 'failure' || needs.winget.result == 'cancelled')

    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: { contents: read, issues: write }
    steps:
      - uses: *Checkout
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: *SetupNode
        with: *Node24
      - name: Ensure a failure issue exists
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: node tools/release/release-assets.mjs report-winget-failure "${VERSION}"
  docker:
    name: Publish tested container bytes
    needs: verify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions: { contents: read, packages: write, id-token: write, attestations: write }
    steps:
      - uses: *Checkout
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: *Download
        with: { name: verified-release, path: "${{ runner.temp }}/release-assets" }
      - name: Install the OCI image copier
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends skopeo
      - uses: &DockerLogin docker/login-action@8aa5831fb8d48d8f76594c7ddde61ae58019f550 # v4.8.0
        with: { registry: ghcr.io, username: "${{ github.repository_owner }}", password: "${{ github.token }}" }
      - uses: *DockerLogin
        with: { username: "${{ github.repository_owner }}", password: "${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}" }
      - name: Copy the exact tested multi-platform image
        id: image
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
          MOVE_LATEST: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.is-latest }}
          MOVE_MAJOR: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.is-major-latest }}
          MOVE_MINOR: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.is-minor-latest }}
        run: |
          tags=("${VERSION}")
          if [[ "${MOVE_LATEST}" == true ]]; then tags+=(latest); fi
          if [[ "${MOVE_MAJOR}" == true ]]; then tags+=("${VERSION%%.*}"); fi
          if [[ "${MOVE_MINOR}" == true ]]; then tags+=("${VERSION%.*}"); fi
          for registry in ghcr.io docker.io; do
            for tag in "${tags[@]}"; do
              skopeo copy --all --preserve-digests --authfile "${HOME}/.docker/config.json" \
                --digestfile "${RUNNER_TEMP}/${registry}.digest" \
                "oci-archive:${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-assets/actionlint-container_${VERSION}.tar" \
                "docker://${registry}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}:${tag}"
              expected="$(cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-assets/actionlint-container_${VERSION}.digest")"
              actual="$(cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/${registry}.digest")"
              test "${actual}" = "${expected}"
            done
          done
          cmp "${RUNNER_TEMP}/ghcr.io.digest" "${RUNNER_TEMP}/docker.io.digest"
          digest="$(cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/ghcr.io.digest")"
          echo "digest=${digest}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Publish the tested Docker Action compatibility image
        id: action-image
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
          MOVE_LATEST: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.is-latest }}
          MOVE_MAJOR: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.is-major-latest }}
          MOVE_MINOR: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.is-minor-latest }}
        run: |
          tags=("action-${VERSION}")
          if [[ "${MOVE_LATEST}" == true ]]; then tags+=(action-latest); fi
          if [[ "${MOVE_MAJOR}" == true ]]; then tags+=("action-v${VERSION%%.*}"); fi
          if [[ "${MOVE_MINOR}" == true ]]; then tags+=("action-v${VERSION%.*}"); fi
          expected="$(cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-assets/actionlint-action-container_${VERSION}.digest")"
          for tag in "${tags[@]}"; do
            skopeo copy --all --preserve-digests --authfile "${HOME}/.docker/config.json" \
              --digestfile "${RUNNER_TEMP}/action-image.digest" \
              "oci-archive:${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-assets/actionlint-action-container_${VERSION}.tar" \
              "docker://ghcr.io/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}:${tag}"
            actual="$(cat "${RUNNER_TEMP}/action-image.digest")"
            test "${actual}" = "${expected}"
          done
          echo "digest=${expected}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Update Docker Hub description
        if: needs.verify.outputs.is-latest == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/dockerhub-description@1b9a80c056b620d92cedb9d9b5a223409c68ddfa # v5.0.0
        with:
          username: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
          repository: ${{ github.repository }}
          short-description: ${{ github.event.repository.description }}
          enable-url-completion: true
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4
        with: { subject-name: "ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}", subject-digest: "${{ steps.image.outputs.digest }}", push-to-registry: true }
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4
        with: { subject-name: "docker.io/${{ github.repository }}", subject-digest: "${{ steps.image.outputs.digest }}" }
      - uses: actions/attest-build-provenance@4d101475d8b20a2381f78447822ac1eab6504dd8 # v4
        with: { subject-name: "ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}", subject-digest: "${{ steps.action-image.outputs.digest }}", push-to-registry: true }
  action-smoke:
    name: Check published Action pins (${{ matrix.os }})
    needs: verify
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 10
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: { os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest, windows-latest, ubuntu-slim] }
    steps:
      - uses: *Checkout
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: *SetupNode
        with: *Node24
      - name: Prepare literal published version and SHA references
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
          CANDIDATE: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.candidate }}
        run: |
          mkdir .published-action-test
          sed -e "s|OWNER/REPO@RELEASE_TAG|${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}@v${VERSION}|g" \
            -e "s|OWNER/REPO@COMMIT_SHA|${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}@${CANDIDATE}|g" \
            applications/github-action/tests/testdata/published-action/action.yml > .published-action-test/action.yml
      - name: Resolve both published references through the runner
        # The prepared composite contains literal external uses references.
        uses: ./.published-action-test
  action-tags:
    name: Update moving Action references
    needs: [verify, npm, distributions, pypi, docker, action-smoke]
    if: >-
      always() && needs.verify.result == 'success' && needs.npm.result == 'success' && needs.docker.result == 'success' &&
      needs.action-smoke.result == 'success' && contains(fromJSON('["success", "skipped"]'), needs.distributions.result) &&
      contains(fromJSON('["success", "skipped"]'), needs.pypi.result)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions: { contents: write }
    steps:
      - uses: *Checkout
        with: { fetch-depth: 0 }
      - name: Update eligible floating tags
        env:
          VERSION: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
          MOVE_MAJOR: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.is-major-latest }}
          MOVE_MINOR: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.is-minor-latest }}
          RELEASE_COMMIT: ${{ needs.verify.outputs.candidate }}
        run: |
          refs=()
          if [[ "${MOVE_MAJOR}" == true ]]; then refs+=("+${RELEASE_COMMIT}:refs/tags/v${VERSION%%.*}"); fi
          if [[ "${MOVE_MINOR}" == true ]]; then refs+=("+${RELEASE_COMMIT}:refs/tags/v${VERSION%.*}"); fi
          if [[ "${#refs[@]}" -gt 0 ]]; then git push --atomic origin "${refs[@]}"; fi

name: Publish Rust SDK
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: SDK version from plugins/sdk/rust/Cargo.toml
        type: string
        required: true
      dry-run:
        description: Verify the package without publishing
        type: boolean
        default: true
      authentication:
        description: Use bootstrap-token only for the first crates.io publication
        type: choice
        options: [trusted-publishing, bootstrap-token]
        default: trusted-publishing

permissions: { contents: read }
defaults: { run: { shell: "bash --noprofile --norc -eo pipefail {0}" } }

jobs:
  verify:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.package.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      - uses: &Checkout actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Install the pinned Rust toolchain
        run: rustup toolchain install
      - name: Check publication target
        id: package
        env:
          EXPECTED_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          DRY_RUN: ${{ inputs.dry-run }}
        run: |
          if [[ "${DRY_RUN}" != true && "${GITHUB_REF}" != refs/heads/master ]]; then
            echo 'SDK publication requires master.' >&2
            exit 1
          fi
          version="$(cargo metadata --locked --no-deps --format-version 1 | jq -er '.packages[] | select(.name == "actionlint-extension-api") | .version')"
          test "${version}" = "${EXPECTED_VERSION}"
          echo "version=${version}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Check SDK formatting
        run: cargo fmt -p actionlint-extension-api --check
      - name: Test default features
        run: cargo test --locked -p actionlint-extension-api
      - name: Test all features
        run: cargo test --locked -p actionlint-extension-api --all-features
      - name: Lint SDK targets
        run: cargo clippy --locked -p actionlint-extension-api --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
      - name: Verify the crates.io package
        run: cargo publish --locked -p actionlint-extension-api --all-features --registry crates-io --dry-run

  publish:
    needs: verify
    if: ${{ !inputs.dry-run && github.ref == 'refs/heads/master' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    environment: { name: crates-io, url: "https://crates.io/crates/actionlint-extension-api/${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}" }
    concurrency:
      group: crates-io-actionlint-extension-api-${{ needs.verify.outputs.version }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions: { contents: read, id-token: write }
    steps:
      - uses: *Checkout
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - name: Install the pinned Rust toolchain
        run: rustup toolchain install
      - name: Authenticate with crates.io
        if: inputs.authentication == 'trusted-publishing'
        uses: rust-lang/crates-io-auth-action@3268eb413133e2960fa4ae0e963ca76380c54cd9 # v1.0.6
        id: auth
      - name: Publish through ${{ inputs.authentication }}
        env: { CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: "${{ case(inputs.authentication == 'trusted-publishing', steps.auth.outputs.token, secrets.CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN) }}" }
        run: cargo publish --locked -p actionlint-extension-api --all-features --registry crates-io

      - run: node tools/docs/readme-demo.mjs --fix ./README.md
        env: { GITHUB_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
      - name: Read the versions the section now describes
        id: versions
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          fork="$(awk '/^\*\*This fork / { print $3; exit }' README.md)"
          upstream="$(awk '/^\*\*Upstream actionlint / { print $3; exit }' README.md)"
          test -n "${fork}" && test -n "${upstream}"
          {
            echo "fork=${fork}"
            echo "upstream=${upstream}"
          } >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Warn when the pull request will carry no CI
        env: { UPKEEP_TOKEN: "${{ secrets.UPKEEP_TOKEN }}" }
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${UPKEEP_TOKEN}" ]]; then
            echo '::warning title=No UPKEEP_TOKEN::GITHUB_TOKEN opens the pull request, and GitHub runs no workflows on it. Store a fine-grained token with contents and pull-requests write as the UPKEEP_TOKEN secret.'
          fi
      - uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@5f6978faf089d4d20b00c7766989d076bb2fc7f1 # v8.1.1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.UPKEEP_TOKEN || github.token }}
          branch: ci/readme-demo
          delete-branch: true
          add-paths: README.md
          commit-message: "Refresh the README demo for fork ${{ steps.versions.outputs.fork }} and upstream ${{ steps.versions.outputs.upstream }}"
          title: "Refresh the README demo for fork ${{ steps.versions.outputs.fork }} and upstream ${{ steps.versions.outputs.upstream }}"
          body: |
            `node tools/docs/readme-demo.mjs --fix` regenerated the demo section with fork `${{ steps.versions.outputs.fork }}` and upstream `${{ steps.versions.outputs.upstream }}`, the latest releases mise resolves.

            Created by [this Upkeep run](${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}).
          labels: |
            documentation
            type:maintenance
          assignees: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
  go-toolchain:
    name: Bump Go toolchain
    if: (github.event_name == 'schedule' || github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch') && github.repository_owner == 'kjanat'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions: { contents: write, pull-requests: write }
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with: { persist-credentials: false }
      - uses: actions/setup-go@b7ad1dad31e06c5925ef5d2fc7ad053ef454303e # v7
        with: { go-version-file: go.mod }
      - uses: actions/setup-node@949feb2413d6458794dcd2491c4babbbce0c15c1 # v7.1.0
        with: { node-version-file: .node-version, package-manager-cache: false }
      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@75c75c31ebece974e48ebc36b4ad125bd97bd97b # 31.11.3
      - uses: $/.github/actions/setup-runner
        with: { version-file: .tool-versions }
      - uses: jdx/mise-action@f5be966e4a917d54244728e6a5fdcd1d93a35e6c # v5.2.6
        with: { install: false, env: false, add_shims_to_path: false, working_directory: "${{ runner.temp }}" }
      - name: Test synchronized toolchain updates
        env: { MISE_TASK_RUN_AUTO_INSTALL: "false" }
        run: run //tools/toolchain:test
      - name: Check the latest stable Go toolchain
        id: version
        env: { GH_TOKEN: "${{ github.token }}" }
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          version="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location 'https://go.dev/VERSION?m=text' | sed -n '1p')"
          if [[ ! "${version}" =~ ^go[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::error title=Invalid Go version::go.dev returned '${version}'"
            exit 1
          fi
          node tools/toolchain/update-go-toolchain.mjs "${version}"
          echo "version=${version}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
      - name: Warn when the pull request will carry no CI
        env: { UPKEEP_TOKEN: "${{ secrets.UPKEEP_TOKEN }}" }
        run: |
          if [[ -z "${UPKEEP_TOKEN}" ]]; then
            echo '::warning title=No UPKEEP_TOKEN::GITHUB_TOKEN opens the pull request, and GitHub runs no workflows on it. Store a fine-grained token with contents and pull-requests write as the UPKEEP_TOKEN secret.'
          fi
      - uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@5f6978faf089d4d20b00c7766989d076bb2fc7f1 # v8.1.1
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.UPKEEP_TOKEN || github.token }}
          branch: ci/go-toolchain-version
          delete-branch: true
          add-paths: |
            go.mod
            .mise.toml
            distribution/docker/Dockerfile
            CONTRIBUTING.md
            flake.nix
            flake.lock
          commit-message: "Bump Go toolchain to ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          title: "Bump Go toolchain to ${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}"
          body: |
            Updates the preferred Go toolchain, mise, Docker builder, contributor example, and verified Nix compiler pin to `${{ steps.version.outputs.version }}`. The minimum supported Go version remains unchanged.

            Created by [this Upkeep run](${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}).
          labels: |
            area:toolchain
            type:maintenance
          assignees: ${{ github.repository_owner }}

# actionlint [![CI Status][ci-badge]][ci] [![Latest release][release-badge]][releases] [![NPM Version][npm-badge]][npm-package] [![pkg.pr.new][preview-badge]][previews] [![Docker image version][docker-badge]][dockerhub] [![Sponsor this project][sponsor-badge]][sponsor] [actionlint][repo] is a static checker for GitHub Actions workflow files. [Try it online!][playground] This is an actively maintained fork of [rhysd/actionlint][upstream]. It carries the upstream checks plus cache safety policies enabled by default, configurable opt-in [policy checks][config], composite action step validation, shell completion, and a first-party GitHub Action, and it ships attested binaries, a Docker image on [GHCR][ghcr] and [Docker Hub][dockerhub]. Report problems through [this fork's issue tracker][issue-form]. ## Fork provenance and versioning This fork builds on upstream [v1.7.12](https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/tag/v1.7.12) ([`rhysd/actionlint@914e7df`]). Its independent release series starts at v1.8.0. Tags published by `kjanat/actionlint` identify this fork's releases; a matching tag need not exist in `rhysd/actionlint`. The [changelog] separates fork releases from inherited upstream history. Releases follow [Semantic Versioning for the supported CLI and configuration contracts], with [CLI compatibility] maintained for existing integrations. New or corrected lint findings can affect CI results. Other programs connect through the [integration interfaces]. ## Features - **Syntax check for workflow files** to check unexpected or missing keys following [workflow syntax][syntax-doc] - **Strong type check for `${{ }}` expressions** to catch several semantic errors like access to not existing property, type mismatches, ... - **Actions usage check** to check that inputs at `with:` and outputs in `steps.{id}.outputs` are correct - **Reusable workflow check** to check inputs/outputs/secrets of reusable workflows and workflow calls - **[shellcheck][shellcheck] integration** for scripts at `run:` - **[Ruff integration](docs/config.md#ruff)** for Python `run:` scripts, without requiring a Python interpreter - **Security checks**; [script injection][script-injection-doc] by untrusted inputs, hard-coded credentials - **Other several useful checks**; [glob syntax][filter-pattern-doc] validation, dependencies check for `needs:`, runner label validation, cron syntax validation, ... See the [full list][checks] of checks done by actionlint.

Example of a broken workflow

## Quick start Install with [npm], [Homebrew], [AUR], [Scoop], [WinGet], or [mise], or download [a release archive][releases]. See [the installation document][install] for all options. To run it through npm: ```sh npx @kjanat/actionlint ``` With a Go toolchain, install it from source: ```sh go install actionlint.kjanat.dev/v2/cmd/actionlint@latest ``` actionlint.kjanat.dev/v2 is a Go vanity import path. The Go toolchain resolves it to this GitHub repository, where the source, releases, and issue tracker live. Further reading available here: GOPROXY protocol. Check for yourself: curl https://proxy.golang.org/actionlint.kjanat.dev/v2/@latest Run `actionlint check` in your repository to discover and check workflows and action manifests. Bare `actionlint` shows help and exits 0; `actionlint check` exits 3 when there is nothing to analyze. ```sh actionlint check ``` Another option to try actionlint is [the online playground][playground]. Your browser can run actionlint through WebAssembly. See [the usage document][usage] for more details. ## GitHub Action Lint with annotations and a compact job summary: ```yaml name: Lint workflows on: [push, pull_request] permissions: { contents: read } jobs: lint: runs-on: ubuntu-latest steps: - uses: actions/checkout@v7 with: { persist-credentials: false } - uses: kjanat/actionlint@v1 ``` Project settings belong in [`.github/actionlint.yaml`](docs/config.md). Use the `config` input for a one-run override. No `with:` block is required. The upcoming JavaScript Action runs on Linux, macOS and Windows without Docker. Pin a published release commit SHA or normal `vX.Y.Z` tag; `v1` and `v1.X` are moving pointers. The first v2 hook release is pending. Exact plugin versions in project configuration select ShellCheck and Ruff Wasm plugins. See [v2 migration](docs/migration-v2.md) for existing hook configurations. ## Documents - [AI usage and policy] and [CLI compatibility]: How this fork uses AI and approaches compatibility for existing workflows and CI integrations. - [Checks][checks]: Full list of all checks done by actionlint with example inputs, outputs, and playground links. - [Installation][install]: Install with npm, Homebrew, AUR, Scoop, WinGet, aqua, mise, the community pip/uv wrapper, release archives, the download script, Docker, or Go. Includes upstream-only package names. - [Usage][usage]: How to use `actionlint` command locally or on GitHub Actions, the online playground, an official Docker image, and integrations with reviewdog, Problem Matchers, super-linter, pre-commit, VS Code. - [Configuration][config]: Runner labels, variables, secrets, default permissions, error filters, and opt-in policy checks, with YAML Language Server schema support. - [Integration interfaces][api]: Use the CLI, language server and plugin SDKs from other programs. - [Schema audit]: Pinned upstream definitions, compatibility fixes, validation evidence, and intentional differences. - [Expression behavior]: Reproduce GitHub's runtime behavior, understand parser differences, and avoid surprising workflow decisions. - [References][refs]: Links to resources. - [GitHub Actions changelog][github-changelog]: Browse and search the latest entries from GitHub's Actions changelog feed. ## Bug reporting When you see some bugs or false positives, it is helpful to [file a new issue][issue-form] with a minimal example of input. # Maintainer: Kaj Kowalski <info@kajkowalski.nl>
# shellcheck disable=SC2034,SC2154
#
# VCS package: builds the tip of master. pkgver() derives the version from
# git describe at build time; the value below only feeds the AUR web page.
pkgname=actionlint-kjanat-git
pkgver=2.0.0.r0.g0000000
pkgrel=1
pkgdesc='Static checker for GitHub Actions workflow files (kjanat fork, git master)'
arch=('x86_64' 'aarch64' 'armv7h')
url='https://actionlint.kjanat.dev'
license=('MIT')
depends=('glibc' 'git')
makedepends=('go' 'pandoc-cli')
optdepends=(
	'ruff: check Python scripts in run steps'
	'shellcheck: check shell scripts in run steps'
)
provides=("actionlint=${pkgver}")
conflicts=('actionlint' 'actionlint-bin' 'actionlint-git' 'actionlint-kjanat' 'actionlint-kjanat-bin')
source=('actionlint::git+https://github.com/kjanat/actionlint.git')
sha256sums=('SKIP')

# Go module path; the ldflags targets below are package-level vars in it.
_module='actionlint.kjanat.dev/v2'

# mise shims on the builder's PATH otherwise apply the repository's mise configs.
_system_tools() {
	export PATH="/usr/bin:${PATH}"
	# Match the system go driver with its own compiler and standard library.
	unset GOROOT
	export MISE_IGNORED_CONFIG_PATHS="${srcdir}/actionlint${MISE_IGNORED_CONFIG_PATHS:+:${MISE_IGNORED_CONFIG_PATHS}}"
}

pkgver() {
	_system_tools
	cd actionlint || exit 1
	local tag
	# v2.0.0-12-gabc1234 -> 2.0.0.r12.gabc1234
	tag="$(git describe --long --abbrev=7 --tags)"
  echo "${tag}" | sed 's/^v//;s/\([^-]*-g\)/r\1/;s/-/./g'
}

prepare() {
	_system_tools
	cd actionlint || exit 1
	go mod download
}

build() {
	_system_tools
	cd actionlint || exit 1
	export CGO_CPPFLAGS="${CPPFLAGS}"
	export CGO_CFLAGS="${CFLAGS}"
	export CGO_CXXFLAGS="${CXXFLAGS}"
	export CGO_LDFLAGS="${LDFLAGS}"
	# A second -ldflags on the command line replaces GOFLAGS' wholesale, so
	# -linkmode=external is passed here and not through GOFLAGS.
	export GOFLAGS='-buildmode=pie -trimpath -mod=readonly -modcacherw'
	# makepkg strips symbols itself; keeping them here lets debuginfod work.
	go build -o build/actionlint \
		-ldflags "-linkmode=external -X ${_module}/internal/integrations/buildinfo.ReleaseVersion=${pkgver} -X ${_module}/internal/integrations/buildinfo.InstallOrigin=https://aur.archlinux.org/packages/${pkgname}" \
		./cmd/actionlint
	pandoc --standalone --from=markdown-smart --syntax-highlighting=none \
		--to=man --metadata=title:ACTIONLINT --lua-filter=man/inline-code-bold.lua \
		--output=man/actionlint.1 man/actionlint.1.md
}

check() {
	_system_tools
	cd actionlint || exit 1
	go test ./cmd/... ./internal/...
}

package() {
	_system_tools
	cd actionlint || exit 1
	install -Dm0755 build/actionlint "${pkgdir}/usr/bin/actionlint"
	install -Dm0644 LICENSE.txt "${pkgdir}/usr/share/licenses/${pkgname}/LICENSE.txt"
	install -Dm0644 README.md "${pkgdir}/usr/share/doc/${pkgname}/README.md"
	install -Dm0644 -t "${pkgdir}/usr/share/doc/${pkgname}/" docs/*.md
	install -Dm0644 man/actionlint.1 "${pkgdir}/usr/share/man/man1/actionlint.1"

	# The binary was just built for $CARCH, so it can generate its own completions.
	install -dm0755 "${pkgdir}/usr/share/bash-completion/completions" \
		"${pkgdir}/usr/share/zsh/site-functions" \
		"${pkgdir}/usr/share/fish/vendor_completions.d" \
		"${pkgdir}/usr/share/actionlint"
	build/actionlint -completion bash >"${pkgdir}/usr/share/bash-completion/completions/actionlint"
	build/actionlint -completion zsh >"${pkgdir}/usr/share/zsh/site-functions/_actionlint"
	build/actionlint -completion fish >"${pkgdir}/usr/share/fish/vendor_completions.d/actionlint.fish"
	# pwsh users dot-source this from their $PROFILE; Linux has no autoload dir for it.
	build/actionlint -completion powershell >"${pkgdir}/usr/share/actionlint/actionlint.ps1"
	chmod 0644 "${pkgdir}/usr/share/bash-completion/completions/actionlint" \
		"${pkgdir}/usr/share/zsh/site-functions/_actionlint" \
		"${pkgdir}/usr/share/fish/vendor_completions.d/actionlint.fish" \
		"${pkgdir}/usr/share/actionlint/actionlint.ps1"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -euo pipefail

if [[ $# -lt 1 || $# -gt 2 ]]; then
	echo "Usage: $0 IMAGE [PLATFORM]" >&2
	exit 2
fi

image="$1"
platform="${2:-linux/amd64}"
fixtures="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)/testdata"
temporary="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf "${temporary}"' EXIT
mkdir -p "${temporary}/workspace/.git" "${temporary}/commands"
tool_environment=()

output() {
	awk -v name="$1" '
        index($0, name "<<") == 1 {
            delimiter = substr($0, length(name) + 3)
            while ((getline line) > 0 && line != delimiter) {
                if (seen) printf "\n"
                printf "%s", line
                seen = 1
            }
            exit
        }
    ' "${temporary}/commands/output"
}

expect_output() {
	local actual
	actual="$(output "$1")"
	if [[ "${actual}" != "$2" ]]; then
		printf 'Expected %s=%s, got %s\n' "$1" "$2" "${actual}" >&2
		cat "${temporary}/action.log" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
}

expect_status() {
	local expected="$1" status=0
	shift
	: >"${temporary}/commands/output"
	docker run --rm --platform "${platform}" \
		--mount "type=bind,source=${temporary}/workspace,target=/github/workspace" \
		--mount "type=bind,source=${temporary}/commands,target=/github/file_commands" \
		--mount "type=bind,source=${fixtures},target=/github/workspace/testdata,readonly" \
		--workdir /github/workspace \
		-e GITHUB_ACTIONS=true -e GITHUB_WORKSPACE=/github/workspace \
		-e GITHUB_OUTPUT=/github/file_commands/output \
		"${tool_environment[@]}" \
		"${image}" "$@" >"${temporary}/action.log" 2>&1 || status=$?
	if [[ "${status}" != "${expected}" ]]; then
		printf 'Expected exit %s, got %s\n' "${expected}" "${status}" >&2
		cat "${temporary}/action.log" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
}

expect_output problems-found false
expect_output problem-count 0
output output | jq -e '.schema_version == 1 and .completed and .status == "success" and .diagnostics == []' >/dev/null

#!/bin/bash

set -e -o pipefail

function usage() {
	echo 'USAGE:' >&2
	echo '  bash download-actionlint.bash [[VERSION] DIR]' >&2
	echo >&2
	echo 'This script downloads actionlint binary from the following release page. curl' >&2
	echo 'command is required as dependency' >&2
	echo 'https://github.com/kjanat/actionlint/releases' >&2
	echo >&2
	echo 'DIR:' >&2
	echo '  Directory to put the downloaded binary (e.g. /path/to/dir). When this value is' >&2
	echo '  omitted, the binary will be put in the current directory.' >&2
	echo >&2
	echo 'VERSION:' >&2
	echo '   Version of actionlint to download. Version must be a specific version' >&2
	echo '   "{major}.{minor}.{patch}" such as "1.6.9" or "latest". When "latest" is' >&2
	echo '   specified or this argument is omitted, the latest version will be selected.' >&2
	echo >&2
	echo 'EXAMPLE:' >&2
	echo '  - Download the latest binary to the current directory' >&2
	echo >&2
	echo '      $ bash download-actionlint.bash' >&2
	echo >&2
	echo '  - Download the latest binary to /usr/bin' >&2
	echo >&2
	echo '      $ bash download-actionlint.bash latest /usr/bin' >&2
	echo >&2
	echo '  - Download version 1.6.9 to the current directory' >&2
	echo >&2
	echo '      $ bash download-actionlint.bash 1.6.9' >&2
	echo >&2
	echo '  - Download version 1.6.9 to /usr/bin' >&2
	echo >&2
	echo '      $ bash download-actionlint.bash 1.6.9 /usr/bin' >&2
}

if [[ "$1" == "-h" || "$1" == "--help" ]]; then
	usage
	exit
fi

# Default value is updated manually on release
version="2.0.0"
if [[ -n "$1" ]]; then
	if [[ "$1" == 'latest' || "$1" == 'LATEST' ]]; then
		latest_url="$(curl --fail --silent --show-error --location --head --output /dev/null --write-out '%{url_effective}' https://github.com/kjanat/actionlint/releases/latest)"
		version="${latest_url##*/v}"
		if [[ ! "${version}" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
			echo "Could not determine the latest version from '${latest_url}'" >&2
			exit 1
		fi
	else
		if [[ "$1" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]; then
			version="$1"
		else
			echo "Given version '$1' does not match to regex '^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$' nor equal to 'latest'" >&2
			echo >&2
			usage
			exit 1
		fi
	fi
fi

target_dir="$(pwd)"
if [[ -n "$2" ]]; then
	if [[ -d "$2" ]]; then
		target_dir="${2%/}"
	else
		echo "Directory '$2' does not exist" >&2
		echo >&2
		usage
		exit 1
	fi
fi

echo "Start downloading actionlint v${version} to ${target_dir}"

case "${OSTYPE}" in
	linux-*)
		os=linux
		ext=tar.gz
		;;
	darwin*)
		os=darwin
		ext=tar.gz
		;;
	freebsd*)
		os=freebsd
		ext=tar.gz
		;;
	msys | cygwin | win32)
		os=windows
		ext=zip
		;;
	*)
		echo "OS '${OSTYPE}' is not supported. Note: If you're using Windows, please ensure bash is used to run this script" >&2
		exit 1
		;;
esac

machine="$(uname -m)"
case "${machine}" in
	x86_64) arch=amd64 ;;
	i?86) arch=386 ;;
	aarch64 | arm64) arch=arm64 ;;
	arm*) arch=armv6 ;;
	*)
		echo "Could not determine arch from machine hardware name '${machine}'" >&2
		exit 1
		;;
esac

echo "Detected OS=${os} ext=${ext} arch=${arch}"

# https://github.com/kjanat/actionlint/releases/download/v1.0.0/actionlint_1.0.0_linux_386.tar.gz
file="actionlint_${version}_${os}_${arch}.${ext}"
url="https://github.com/kjanat/actionlint/releases/download/v${version}/${file}"

echo "Downloading ${url} with curl"

tempdir="$(mktemp -d actionlint.XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tempdir"' EXIT
archive="${tempdir}/${file}"
curl --fail --location --output "${archive}" "${url}"

if command -v gh >/dev/null && gh auth status >/dev/null 2>&1; then
	echo "Verifying ${file} against its build provenance attestation"
	gh attestation verify "${archive}" --repo kjanat/actionlint
else
	echo "Skipping attestation verification of ${file}: gh is not installed or not authenticated" >&2
fi

if [[ "${os}" == "windows" ]]; then
	unzip "${archive}" actionlint.exe -d "${target_dir}"
	exe="${target_dir}/actionlint.exe"
else
	tar xvz -f "${archive}" -C "${target_dir}" actionlint
	exe="${target_dir}/actionlint"
fi

rm -rf "${tempdir}"
trap - EXIT

echo "Downloaded and unarchived executable: ${exe}"

installed_version="$("${exe}" -version)"
echo "Done: ${installed_version}"

if [[ -n "${GITHUB_ACTION}" ]]; then
	# On GitHub Actions, set executable path to output
	if [[ -n "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}" ]]; then
		echo "executable=${exe}" >>"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
	else
		# GitHub Enterprise instance may not introduce the new set-output command yet (see #240)
		echo "::set-output name=executable::${exe}"
	fi
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash

set -o pipefail
set -e

if [[ ! -d .git ]]; then
	echo 'This script must be run from root of repository' >&2
	exit 1
fi

set -x

script="$(pwd)/distribution/install/download-actionlint.bash"
temp_dir="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'popd && rm -rf $temp_dir' EXIT
pushd "${temp_dir}"

# Normal cases
set -e

check_latest_version() {
	local executable="$1"
	local out first_line version

	out="$("${executable}" -version)"
	first_line="${out%%$'\n'*}"
	version="${first_line#actionlint.kjanat.dev/v2 }"
	version="${version#actionlint.kjanat.dev }"
	if [[ ! "${version}" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]] \
		|| [[ "${out}" != *"https://github.com/kjanat/actionlint/releases/tag/v${version}"* ]]; then
		echo "Output from ${executable} -version is unexpected: '${out}'" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
}

download() {
	local out output

	: >"${github_output}"
	out="$(GITHUB_ACTION=true GITHUB_OUTPUT="${github_output}" bash "${script}" "$@")"
	output="$(<"${github_output}")"
	if [[ "${output}" != executable=* || "${output}" == *$'\n'* || -z "${output#executable=}" ]]; then
		echo "'executable' step output is not set correctly in ${github_output}:" >&2
		cat "${github_output}" >&2
		echo "Download script output: '${out}'" >&2
		exit 1
	fi

	executable="${output#executable=}"
	if [[ ! -f "${executable}" ]]; then
		echo "Downloaded executable does not exist: '${executable}'" >&2
		echo "Download script output: '${out}'" >&2
		exit 1
	fi
}

# Latest release
github_output="${temp_dir}/github-output"
download latest
check_latest_version "${executable}"
rm -f "${executable}"

# Specify only version
download '1.8.0'
out="$("${executable}" -version | head -n 1)"
if [[ "${out}" != '1.8.0' ]]; then
	echo "Unexpected version: '${out}'" 1>&2
	exit 1
fi
rm -f "${executable}"

# Specify only a download directory
mkdir ./test1
download latest ./test1
check_latest_version "${executable}"
rm -rf ./test1

# Specify both version and a download directory
mkdir ./test2
download '1.8.0' ./test2
out="$("${executable}" -version | head -n 1)"
if [[ "${out}" != '1.8.0' ]]; then
	echo "Unexpected version: '${out}'" 1>&2
	exit 1
fi
rm -rf ./test2

# Error cases
set +e

fails=0
if bash "${script}" 'v1.8.0'; then
	echo "FAIL: Invalid version at the first argument did not cause any error" >&2
	((fails++))
fi
if bash "${script}" './this/dir/does/not/exist'; then
	echo "FAIL: Directory which does not exist at the first argument did not cause any error" >&2
	((fails++))
fi
if bash "${script}" '999999999999999999.9.9'; then
	echo "FAIL: Unknown version at the first argument did not cause any error" >&2
	((fails++))
fi

set -e
if [[ "${fails}" != "0" ]]; then
	echo "${fails} error cases failed. Check the above log" >&2
	exit 1
fi

echo 'SUCCESS'

files.tools/ci/autofix-step.bash:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

output_file=${GITHUB_OUTPUT:?GITHUB_OUTPUT must name the step output file}

temporary=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -f "${temporary}/index" "${temporary}/index.lock"; rmdir "${temporary}"' EXIT

# Compare each step's changes, including new files, without touching the real index.
snapshot() {
	GIT_INDEX_FILE="${temporary}/index" git read-tree HEAD || return
	GIT_INDEX_FILE="${temporary}/index" git -c core.fileMode=false add --all || return
	GIT_INDEX_FILE="${temporary}/index" git write-tree
}

before=$(snapshot)
"$@"
after=$(snapshot)

if [[ "${before}" != "${after}" ]]; then
	echo 'changed=true' >>"${output_file}"
else
	echo 'changed=false' >>"${output_file}"
fi
files.tools/ci/test-autofix-step.bash:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

script=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)/autofix-step.bash
inputs_script=$(cd "$(dirname "$0")" && pwd)/autofix-inputs.bash
temp_root=$(cd "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}" && pwd -P)
temporary=$(mktemp -d "${temp_root}/actionlint-autofix-test.XXXXXX")
cleanup() {
	cd "${temp_root}"
	case "${temporary}" in
		"${temp_root}"/actionlint-autofix-test.*) rm -rf -- "${temporary}" ;;
		*) return 1 ;;
	esac
}
trap cleanup EXIT
mkdir "${temporary}/snapshots"
export TMPDIR="${temporary}/snapshots" GITHUB_OUTPUT="${temporary}/output"

git init --quiet "${temporary}/repo"
cd "${temporary}/repo"
git config core.autocrlf false
git config core.hooksPath "${temporary}/hooks"
echo original >tracked
echo ignored >.gitignore
git add --all
git -c user.name=Test -c user.email=test@example.com -c commit.gpgsign=false commit --quiet -m fixture

expect_change() {
	local expected=$1
	local output leftover
	shift
	: >"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
	bash "${script}" "$@"
	read -r output <"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
	[[ "${output}" == "changed=${expected}" ]]
	leftover=$(find "${TMPDIR}" -mindepth 1 -print -quit)
	[[ -z "${leftover}" ]]
}

expect_change false true
expect_change true bash -c 'echo modernized > tracked'
expect_change false true
# Formatting the same file must still count as a separate change.
expect_change true bash -c 'echo formatted > tracked'
expect_change true bash -c 'echo generated > new-file'
expect_change true rm new-file
expect_change false bash -c 'echo cache > ignored'
expect_change false chmod +x tracked

# Preserve both staged and unstaged changes in the caller's index.
git add tracked
echo unstaged >tracked
index_before=$(git hash-object .git/index)
expect_change false true
expect_change true bash -c 'echo updated > tracked'
index_after=$(git hash-object .git/index)
[[ "${index_after}" == "${index_before}" ]]

# A failed tool must fail the step without publishing a success output.
: >"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
status=0
bash "${script}" bash -c 'echo partial > tracked; exit 7' || status=$?
[[ "${status}" == 7 ]]
[[ ! -s "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}" ]]
leftover=$(find "${TMPDIR}" -mindepth 1 -print -quit)
[[ -z "${leftover}" ]]

# Exercise selection against real Git trees, including added and removed inputs.
expect_inputs() {
	local base=$1 head=$2 tables=$3 readme=$4
	local output
	: >"${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
	bash "${inputs_script}" "${base}" "${head}"
	output=$(cat "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}")
	[[ "${output}" == "$(printf 'tables=%s\nreadme=%s' "${tables}" "${readme}")" ]]
}

check_input() {
	local path=$1 tables=$2 readme=$3
	local base head directory
	base=$(git write-tree)
	directory=$(dirname "${path}")
	mkdir -p "${directory}"
	echo fixture >"${path}"
	git add --all
	head=$(git write-tree)
	expect_inputs "${base}" "${head}" "${tables}" "${readme}"
	expect_inputs "${head}" "${base}" "${tables}" "${readme}"
}

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# Exercise an installed binary or launcher: check-packaged-cli.bash COMMAND [ARG...]
# Requires bash, git and jq. Command paths must survive changing directories.
set -euo pipefail

smoke=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf -- "${smoke}"' EXIT
cd "${smoke}"
git init --quiet
mkdir -p .github/workflows
cat >.github/workflows/clean.yml <<'YAML'
on: push
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - run: echo ok
YAML

"$@" check .github/workflows/clean.yml --no-config --shellcheck= --pyflakes= --json >clean.json
jq -e '.schema_version == 1 and .diagnostics == []' clean.json

cat >broken.yml <<'YAML'
on: push
jobs: []
YAML
status=0
"$@" check broken.yml --no-config --shellcheck= --pyflakes= --json >broken.json || status=$?
test "${status}" -eq 1
jq -e '.schema_version == 1 and (.diagnostics | length > 0)' broken.json

cat >.github/actionlint.yaml <<'YAML'
plugins: []
config-variables: [PACKAGE_SMOKE]
YAML
"$@" config show --origin --json >config.json
jq -e '.config.repository.variables == {"PACKAGE_SMOKE": null} and .origins["/repository/variables"].source == "config"' config.json

"$@" rules --json >rules.json
jq -e 'type == "array" and any(.[]; .name == "syntax-check")' rules.json

for shell in bash zsh fish powershell; do
	"$@" completion "${shell}" >"${shell}.completion"
	test -s "${shell}.completion"
	grep -q '__complete' "${shell}.completion"
	# Package installers still use the legacy spelling; it must generate the same script.
	"$@" -completion "${shell}" >"${shell}.legacy"
	cmp "${shell}.completion" "${shell}.legacy"
done
echo 'Packaged CLI smoke checks passed.'
